model.title: South China Sea Strategy Act of 2026
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. Tammy Duckworth (D-IL)

summary.text: The bill would require the federal government to develop and implement a comprehensive diplomatic strategy for engaging with countries in the South China Sea region. It aims to guide U.S. foreign policy efforts in this strategically important area through coordinated diplomatic engagement.
